draft_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
revised_text: On the Brindle-Voice test set, Brisling may decode faster than Talmar (median latency 41 vs 118 ms per utterance).
rationale: The claim reports median latencies 41 vs 118 ms from T1.r1.lat and T1.r2.lat, correctly attributed to Brisling and Talmar on Brindle-Voice. The hedge "may" appropriately reflects that latencies were measured on different accelerators (A2 fp16 vs A1 fp32), so no stronger claim is warranted.
